meta.name: baoyu-danger-x-to-markdown
meta.description: Converts X (Twitter) tweets and articles to markdown with YAML front matter. Uses reverse-engineered API requiring user consent. Use when user mentions "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provides x.com/twitter.com URLs for conversion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把X推文和文章转成带元数据的Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要保存X平台的内容到本地做笔记或备份。
copy.tagline_en: Convert X tweets and articles to Markdown with YAML front matter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to save X content locally for notes or backup.

howto.what: 当用户给出 X(推特)链接时，Claude 会先征求同意，然后把推文或文章生成带作者、链接等信息的 Markdown 文件；还可选择下载里面的图片视频到本地。
howto.when: 当用户提到“X to markdown”、“tweet to markdown”等意图，或直接提供 x.com/twitter.com 的链接时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这条推文转成 Markdown
say.note: 推文会被转成 Markdown 文件并保存到本地

say.text: 把这篇 X 文章保存成 Markdown
say.note: 文章内容会被提取并保存为 Markdown 文件

say.text: 下载这条推文里的图片和视频
say.note: 媒体会保存到本地 imgs/ 和 videos/ 文件夹

howto.what_en: Converts X (Twitter) tweets/threads and articles to Markdown with YAML front matter. Requires user consent before any conversion; optionally downloads media to local folders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'X to markdown', 'tweet to markdown', or provides an x.com/twitter.com URL for conversion.

say_en.note: A Markdown file is saved locally with the tweet.

say_en.text: Save this X article as Markdown.
say_en.note: Its content is extracted and saved as a Markdown file.

say_en.text: Download images and videos from this tweet.
say_en.note: Media is saved into imgs/ and videos/ folders.
